item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00277","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C21","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is an unmistakable country-substitution template for the child. Both quote the same statutory authority, recite receipt of satisfactory proof of reciprocal nondiscrimination, and use virtually identical operative language suspending tonnage and impost duties from the notification date for as long as reciprocity continues. C21 is another very close instance of the same template, but C10 is marginally closer in wording. C01 shares only the more general proclamation structure of statutory quotation, factual finding, and tax suspension or termination.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas section 4228 of the Revised Statutes of the United States ... provides, in part, as follows","parent_excerpt":"Whereas section 4228 of the Revised Statutes of the United States ... provides, in part, as follows","explanation":"The child and C10 invoke and reproduce the same specific statutory authority."},{"child_excerpt":"And Whereas satisfactory proof was received by me from the Government of Pakistan on September 10, 1949, that nondiscriminating duties of tonnage or imposts are imposed or levied in the ports of Pakistan","parent_excerpt":"And Whereas satisfactory proof was received by me from the Government of Israel on April 18, 1949 that no discriminating duties of tonnage or imposts are imposed or levied in the ports of Israel","explanation":"The factual recital has the same syntax and function, with only the government, date, and corresponding country references changed. The child's apparent omission of 'no' is best understood as a textual error rather than a structural difference."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby declare and proclaim that the foreign discriminating duties of tonnage and imposts within the United States are suspended and discontinued so far as respects the vessels of Pakistan ...; the suspension to take effect from September 10, 1949, and to continue so long as the reciprocal exemption ... shall be continued, and no longer","parent_excerpt":"do hereby declare and proclaim that the foreign discriminating duties of tonnage and imposts within the United States are suspended and discontinued so far as respects the vessels of Israel ...; the suspension to take effect from April 18, 1949, and to continue so long as the reciprocal exemption ... shall be continued, and no longer","explanation":"The complete operative provision is materially identical, including the scope of suspension, effective-date mechanism, and reciprocity-based duration."}]}
